**Result: Compliant — no redline proposed.**

§ (h) satisfies the ASSIGN rule at or near the preferred position:

- **AP's assignment rights:** free assignment without consent to (i) any affiliate, (ii) a purchaser of all or substantially all assets related to the subject matter, and (iii) any successor by merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction — the full M&A carve-out we ask for.
- **Consent standard:** for other assignments, consent "shall not be unreasonably withheld."
- **Change of control:** no "change of control" language exists anywhere in the Agreement, and the termination provisions give Kubient no termination or re-pricing right on an AP change of control. Walk-away triggers are absent.

Noted but not flagged (minor sub-elements): the clause is mutual rather than one-way in our favour, and there is no express prohibition on Kubient assigning to an AP competitor. The "non-assignable" wording in the § 2 Kubient License is a licence-scope limit on the ad-serving technology grant, not an Agreement-level assignment restriction.
